summary: Package a standalone graph-free light-node seat agent with durable native custody, an opt-in Linux user service and own-process CPU/work accounting

replay.detail: Canonical wire, authentication, authority, custody and session implementations move into dependency-minimal shared crates without changing their wire encodings or existing journal replay fences. No graph is copied, rehydrated or silently adopted.

schema.detail: The standalone agent has an explicit version-1 private operator configuration and a private Unix /v1/performance response. Physical CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID counters include all agent threads and exclude children/home. Per-accounting-instance UUID, PID, baseline, monotonic sample brackets and bounded observed-work counters describe their actual scope; failed measurements are explicit, not zero observations.

rules.detail: The binary accepts only authenticated, pinned Observe/Stop agent sessions. Start remains a typed light-node-start-not-supported refusal. Explicit exact native custody provisioning requires positive physical generation/provenance and current authority; configured future epochs defer provisioning until their paired journal drain completes. Native entry requires acknowledged home authority. Logical detach and exact positive native retirement proofs remain distinct; process absence or reused generations never invent proof.

compatibility.detail: Existing full-node callers use the same canonical shared types and implementations. Graph-backed home effects remain in Store; the agent's normal dependency closure excludes Store, graph, replication and full-node reconciliation. No remote-Start or shared-capacity reservation implementation is imported from an unlanded branch.

downtime.detail: Installation is not a production cutover, deployment, membership retirement, route-parity or CPU-budget claim. Agent transport/service termination preserves healthy native processes and retained custody for restart.

manual.detail: Run fractal-light-node-agent --config with a private owned regular operator JSON file and existing private credentials; special files are rejected without waiting for a FIFO writer. Native roots must already be owned real directories without group/other writes. State/native roots require physical absolute paths with no ancestor symlinks: every ancestor must be owned by the executing user or root, with group/other writes permitted only on sticky directories. Private-state ancestry is checked before and after recursive creation, before authoritative files are opened. The opt-in Linux Home Manager service takes an absolute external configFile string, never Nix-store secrets, and conservatively rejects an enabled same-user full Fractal service. It starts only the minimal agent and pinned sibling PTY, with bounded failure restart and KillMode=process. No Darwin service or automatic graph-to-journal custody transfer is provided.

recovery.detail: An exclusive private state-directory lock prevents duplicate agents from replacing the live local API socket. Retained journal state is never truncated or permission-repaired. Restart repairs pending native finalization before session receipt exposure; identical retained explicit metadata cannot resurrect settled or borrowed custody. Cancellation's exact authority revision stays durably revoked after refresh, home acknowledgment and restart without terminating a healthy native process or silently readmitting it. Session events drive binding refresh and reconnect without a background CPU sampler or watchdog poller. The required systemd-user KVM lane exercises real standalone agent restart, native scope survival and positive whole-scope retirement.
